collection_elapsed_scope: whole collection orchestration wall duration; not summed CPU, scan latency, or an effect-size measure
limits: Process CPU includes startup, executable hashing, setup, warm scan, scan, verification, hashing, output and destruction; it is not scan-only CPU.
Controller CPU is excluded; waited descendants follow OS accounting. Peak RSS is whole-process observation, not allocation counts.
Host cache pressure, frequency and performance/efficiency-core placement are uncontrolled; CPU measurements are not noise-free.
No wall-clock speedup, scan latency, throughput, energy, allocation improvement, portable performance or release qualification is claimed.
Passing a guard criterion does not establish zero regression. Positive decode paired CPU changes are retained in both rounds.
All ordered samples and all twenty cells are retained, including failed acceptance. No threshold was changed and the rejected helper is excluded from production.
Raw commands, private paths, environment values, monotonic timestamps, findings and compile-action keys remain private; digests bind retained originals.

protocol.aa_rule: median absolute paired deviation <= 5%; at least four of five absolute deviations <= 10%
protocol.control_rule: median deviation > M and all three deviations > 0
protocol.guard_rule: each guard median deviation <= M in each round; rounds are not pooled
protocol.margin_rule: M = max(5%, 2 * median absolute A/A paired deviation), frozen before controls and candidates
protocol.paired_deviation: (CPU_B - CPU_A) / CPU_A; CPU is the whole-child user plus system observation
protocol.primary_rule: dense and complete CLI separately: median deviation < -M and at least four of five deviations < 0 in each round
protocol.threshold_scope: prospective practical decision threshold; not a confidence interval, clock-precision bound or release tolerance

public_field_definitions.compile_action_identity_sha256: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of the raw Bazel compile-action key; a build identity digest, not a credential
